Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling)

Annapolis, MD · Downtown · Road

No-drop

Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling) is a road group ride in Annapolis, MD. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Prince George St at USNA Barry Gate. About 35–45 miles, 16–18 mph average.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @abrtcycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling) group ride

A team-hosted no-drop road ride from downtown Annapolis with many regroup points. Thirty-five to forty-five miles at 16 to 18 mph. Start time moves with the season. The team's Saturday ride from Davidsonville is faster and only the B group waits.
